'''Baked lamb and yogurt''' ('''tavë kosi)''', is an Albanian recipe.

==Ingredients==

=== Lamb ===
*1½ [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] (680 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Lamb|lamb]]
*4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] (½ stick or 50 g) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*2 tablespoons (30 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
*[[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]]

=== Yogurt sauce ===
* 1 tablespoon [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 4 tablespoons (½ stick or 50 g) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 2 lb (900 g) [[Cookbook:Yogurt|yogurt]]
* 5 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* Salt
* Pepper

== Procedure ==

# Cut meat into 4 serving pieces, and sprinkle each piece with salt and pepper. [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in a moderately-heated [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] with half the butter, basting the meat with its gravy now and then.
# When meat is half-baked, add rice. Remove the baking pan from the oven and leave it aside while you prepare the yogurt sauce.
# [[Cookbook:Sautéing|Sauté]] flour in butter until mixed thoroughly. Mix yogurt with salt, pepper and eggs until a uniform mixture is obtained, and finally stir in the flour-butter mix. Put the sauce mixture in the baking pan; stir it with the meat pieces.
# Bake at 375°F (190°C) for about 45 minutes. Serve hot.
